findings: Full JavaScript SDK API reference. Both captures list 28 methods in the top-level index and 21 error-code rows, including seven printer codes.

The app obtains a backend ConnectionToken in onFetchConnectionToken. Account switching changes the token handler, clears cached credentials and reconnects after disconnecting any existing reader. Avoid caching the returned reader because its IP can change.

Payment collection consumes a backend PaymentIntent client secret. Processing takes the successfully collected Intent and returns a confirmed Intent or an error. SetupIntent collection requires its backend-generated client secret and allowRedisplay, then confirmation consumes the returned SetupIntent. Refund processing requires successful refund collection. The operations and their outstanding-command cancellations are separate.
